Service information

Updated 18 October 2026

Call before booking

Tell Clive your vehicle or equipment details, location and the work required. Availability, travel, job suitability and timing are confirmed directly. An enquiry does not confirm a booking or a response time.

Scope and charges

Before agreeing to work, discuss the scope, expected timing, parts, labour, travel and any diagnostic or call out charges. Ask which charges apply and how additional work will be approved. The information on this website is general and does not diagnose a fault or confirm that a vehicle or machine is safe to operate.

Your consumer rights

Nothing on this website excludes rights or remedies that cannot be excluded under Australian Consumer Law. For a concern about work or an invoice, contact Clive on 0474 372 852 with the job details.

Urgent situations

For an immediate emergency or danger, call 000. Sampson’s website is not an emergency dispatch service. Call Clive to check availability for mechanical assistance. Text messages may not be seen immediately.

Illustrative assemblies and machinery

Vehicle and machinery imagery is illustrative. The 3D gallery shows complete assembly and machinery examples. They are not photographs of customer work or a promise that every shown part is serviced. Discuss your particular vehicle, machine or component with Clive. Read image and model credits.
